time.clock_binding: every cycles->seconds conversion requires an explicit clock_hz > 0 bound into performance_model_id; no default 1 GHz

exclusive.law: claims <= capacity at every instant; admit by (earliest ready, semantic event id); never start before a predecessor ends
exclusive.known_property: FIFO admits by identity order, so under capacity contention it is NOT makespan-optimal; the brute-force oracle records the counterexample (3 independent jobs 1,1,2 on capacity 2: FIFO 3us, optimum 2us). Optimality is a property of a chosen policy, not of feasibility.

bandwidth.law: fluid equal share among active transfers; a transfer joins at its own ready time; sum(active) <= bandwidth_bytes_per_s; event-driven, no fixed timesteps

network_timing.authority: BookSim evidence via sealed Wave-B/D qualified path only; Wave E never re-derives traffic or contention
network_timing.window_rule: the whole traffic window is one BARRIER-network event with duration = completion_time / network_clock_hz; per-op causal completion is UNSUPPORTED
network_timing.no_double_contention: analytical NoC contention over BookSim-simulated traffic is refused

metrics.critical_path: longest causal chain of the scheduled DAG, by semantic identity tie-break; not largest busy time
metrics.utilization: occupied capacity-time / (capacity x makespan) per exclusive resource
metrics.request_latency: completion - arrival for events bound to an explicit request; per-request stats require sample_count
metrics.ttft: first token completion - arrival; requires explicit request + first-token completion event, else UNSUPPORTED
metrics.tpot: decode-step cadence from explicit step identities, else UNSUPPORTED
metrics.exposed_network: counterfactual: makespan_baseline - makespan(network duration -> 0); not total network active time
metrics.attribution: non-additive; sensitivity/counterfactual quantities are reported per-parameter, never summed to makespan

scheduler.algorithm: deterministic discrete-event; event boundaries are dependency completions, resource releases, bandwidth completions
scheduler.tie_break: semantic event id; no set iteration, no host time
scheduler.deadlock: unfinished events with no runnable progress -> typed SchedulerDeadlock (never a spin)

sensitivity.method: re-run the schedule under explicit parameter perturbations (e.g. 0.5x/2x); no algebraic shortcut
sensitivity.elasticity: ((T2 - T0.5)/T1) / (2 - 0.5), sign convention: positive elasticity means bigger/faster parameter shortens makespan
sensitivity.zero_cost_counterfactual: duration -> 0 for one source class measures exposed contribution, not active time
sensitivity.identity: each perturbation is a distinct derived evaluation identity bound to base model + perturbation

persistence.authenticity: requested filename id == embedded resource_id == recomputed canonical-content id; closed field sets; verified parents; schema-close result refuses unknown fields; summaries re-derived from schedule on load

calibration.reason: no measured per-operation timing dataset in the repository
calibration.rule: a calibrated claim requires dataset hash, device identity, fit parameters, held-out error metrics and a validity domain; none exists, so analytical/explicit models are labeled accordingly and no empirical accuracy is claimed

unsupported_matrix.llmservingsim_integration: BLOCKED (external contract missing, unchanged from Wave D)

result_provenance_binding.rule: the verified plan's wave_e binding is the authority; the result's block must claim it and the schedule is re-run
checks: the temporal workload resource re-verifies from the store and its model id matches
result.wave_e.wave_d_chain == plan.wave_d on every chain field
network_binding.evidence_sha256 == this run's authenticated evidence digest
network_binding.stats_sha256 == canonical digest of this run's authenticated stats
network_binding.{operation_graph_id, physical_traffic_id, backend_config_hash, backend_input_hash} == their authorities
plan_level: plan.wave_e resolves to a persisted verified temporal workload
every declared waved operation id exists in the plan's operation graph
